inworld/name01_hasti.heard: That's the rest paid. You owe the Bureau nothing, Miss Nicolau.
inworld/name01_hasti.line: That's the rest paid. You owe the Bureau nothing, Miss Nikolaou.

inworld/name02_hasti.heard: Fair enough, Lukach. A couple of minutes, we'll be at the bay.
inworld/name02_hasti.line: Fair enough, Lukac. A couple of minutes. We'll be at the bay.

inworld/name03_lukac.heard: It's paid then. It's been a lean month. For what? Exactly.
inworld/name03_lukac.line: It's paid, then. It's been a lean month. For what, exactly?

inworld/name04_arthur.heard: It's only a door. Alright, I'm coming.
inworld/name04_arthur.line: It's only a door. All right, I'm coming.

inworld/name07_sethre.heard: The loop's running. Two minutes. Lardy.
inworld/name07_sethre.line: The loop's running. Two minutes, Larthi.

inworld/name08_popovic.heard: Councillor Popovich, I'll take my car now.
inworld/name08_popovic.line: Councillor Popovic. I'll take my car now.

inworld/scene01_milena.heard: Have you eaten? You've looked at that office door all shift.
inworld/scene01_milena.line: Have you eaten? You've looked at that Office door all shift.

inworld/scene02_inez.heard: Eat with the bureau after me, waiting tables I can't keep up.
inworld/scene02_inez.line: Eat? With the Bureau after me? Waiting tables, I can't keep up.

inworld/scene03_milena.heard: I owe them too. We'll be buried with those cards half stamped.
inworld/scene03_milena.line: I owe them too. We'll be buried with those cards half stamped.

inworld/scene04_inez.heard: Then bury me somewhere I can sit down.
inworld/scene04_inez.line: Then bury me somewhere I can sit down.

inworld/scene05_milena.heard: You'd get up to look at that door. Is it so handsome?
inworld/scene05_milena.line: You'd get up to look at that door. Is it so handsome?

inworld/scene06_inez.heard: Who says? Did Arthur say something? Who else has he told?
inworld/scene06_inez.line: Who says? Did Arthur say something? Who else has he told?

inworld/scene07_milena.heard: He said nothing, you goose. You just did.
inworld/scene07_milena.line: He said nothing, you goose. You just did.

inworld/scene08_inez.heard: Yes, I'm seeing him. If the office hears, it costs us both.
inworld/scene08_inez.line: Yes, I'm seeing him. If the Office hears, it costs us both.

inworld/scene09_milena.heard: Not for me, they won't. Stop looking, though. You can't afford it.
inworld/scene09_milena.line: Not from me, they won't. Stop looking, though. You can't afford it.

inworld/scene10_larthi.heard: Bureau loan behind could be cleared. Arthur office door could be used.
inworld/scene10_larthi.line: Bureau loan, behind, could be cleared. Arthur, Office door, could be used.

inworld/shout01_arthur.heard: Hold it. No running in the square.
inworld/shout01_arthur.line: Hold it! No running in the square!

inworld/shout02_arthur.heard: Weapon, drop it, drop it now.
inworld/shout02_arthur.line: Weapon! Drop it! Drop it now!

inworld/shout03_arthur.heard: Armed men, not in my square.
inworld/shout03_arthur.line: Armed men! Not in my square!

inworld/shout05_larthi.heard: That car's on fire. Get clear.
inworld/shout05_larthi.line: That car's on fire. Get clear!

inworld/shout10_watcher.heard: Gun on camera. Call it in.
inworld/shout10_watcher.line: Gun on camera! Call it in!
